results.title: Rivers State government and China’s National Engineering Group Corporation (CNCECC) have signed a deal for building a new methanol and ferti
results.description:
Rivers State  government and China’s National Engineering Group Corporation (CNCECC) have signed a deal for building a new methanol and  fertiliser facility at Bonny, an industrial hub which is also housing the multi-billion-dollar Nigerian Liquefied National Gas company.

Rivers government through its Investment Promotion Agency (RSIPA) signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with CNCECC for the proposed methanol and fertiliser plant in Bonny Local  Government Area.

results.title: SLIPPERY IVE NOT GONE ANYWHERE BLAIR STRIKES AGAIN......
results.description:
SLIPPERY IVE NOT GONE ANYWHERE BLAIR STRIKES AGAIN......
The Tony Blair institute  has spent years advising Nigeria's president on trade , power and agriculture and a British Lithium firm says its mining leases were revoked and handed to Chinese interests whilst Blairs people were in the romm.
Jupiter Lithium claims it found deposits big enough to supply Britain for decades, protected under a UK/Nigeria treaty then lost everything .
Blairs office says mining was never discussed.
Nigeria calls it a smear .
Either way a declared UK national security priority just slipped through Britain's fingers and the man who was supposed to be helping is the one with questions to answer ....

results.title: No exhaustive public list exists of every Tinubu-era foreign investment that has produced confirmed Nigerian jobs.
results.description:
No exhaustive public list exists of every Tinubu-era foreign investment that has produced confirmed Nigerian jobs. Actual FDI inflows remain far below announced pledges.

Examples include the Chinese $250m lithium plant in Nasarawa (Diamond New Energy), which reports over 1,000 direct and 2,000 indirect jobs, and the $200m Zamfara plant (Chinese partners) targeting 2,000 local jobs. The $7bn Ogun DP World seaport deal is still an MoU projecting 50,000 jobs.

results.description:
HIRING

Chinese Translator | AVATAR New Energy Materials Company Limited

📍 Location: Kama Otto, Nasarawa State
Job Type: Full-time, On-site
Compensation: ₦400,000–₦500,000 per month (Negotiable)
Job Field: Translation / Interpretation

About the Role

AVATAR New Energy Materials Company Limited, a Chinese company specialising in lithium exploration, mining, and processing in Nigeria, is seeking a fluent Chinese Translator to support communication between Chinese management and Nigerian production staff.

Key Responsibilities

• Translate written documents and interpret spoken communication between Chinese and English.
• Interpret meetings and on-site discussions between Chinese management and Nigerian production staff.
• Facilitate communication between the Head of Production, management, and workers.
• Translate production documents, daily reports, work instructions, and technical materials.
• Assist the Head of Production in supervising daily factory activities.
• Monitor production activities and ensure workers understand and follow supervisors’ instructions.
• Communicate production targets, schedules, and operational procedures clearly.
• Support production meetings, technical training, and equipment instructions.
• Resolve communication gaps and promote mutual understanding between Chinese and Nigerian staff.

Requirements

• https://t.co/cqTb3tLWTm. degree.
• 2–3 years of relevant experience.
• Experience in translation or interpretation, preferably in mining, business, or technical environments.
• Fluency in spoken and written Chinese and English.
• Hausa speaking and listening skills are an advantage.
• Experience studying or working in China is an advantage.
• Strong sense of responsibility and good management skills.

How to Apply

📧 Apply via: Send your CV to hr@avtne.com with the subject “Chinese Translator”.

For enquiries, WhatsApp 08058915717.

Application Deadline: 16 November 2026.

results.title: HIRING HR Assistant | Avatar New Energy Materials Co.
results.description:
HIRING

HR Assistant | Avatar New Energy Materials Co. Limited

📍 Location: Nasarawa State
Job Type: Full-time
Compensation: ₦130,000–₦160,000 monthly

About the Role

Avatar New Energy Materials Co. Limited, a Chinese company specialising in lithium exploration, mining, and processing in Nigeria, is seeking an entry-level HR Assistant to support recruitment, employee records, staff welfare, and daily HR operations in a mining and industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist with recruitment activities, including job postings, CV screening, interview scheduling, and onboarding.
• Maintain and update employee files, records, and HR databases.
• Support employee onboarding and orientation.
• Assist with attendance tracking, leave management, and basic payroll documentation.
• Handle employee inquiries and escalate issues when necessary.
• Support the implementation of HR policies, procedures, and company rules.
• Coordinate training programmes, meetings, and staff activities.
• Assist with employee welfare and disciplinary documentation.
• Maintain the confidentiality of employee information.

• Perform other HR and administrative duties as assigned.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Public Relations, or a related field.
• 1–2 years of experience is an advantage.
• Basic knowledge of HR practices and Nigerian labour laws.
• Good written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong organisational and record-keeping skills.
• High level of integrity and professionalism.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
• Willingness to work in a mining or site environment.
• Open to male and female candidates aged 23–27.

Skills & Competencies

• Attention to detail.
• Time management and multitasking ability.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Ability to handle sensitive information confidentially.
• Team-oriented mindset.

How to Apply

📧 Apply via: Send your CV to hr@avtne.com using “HR ASSISTANT” as the email subject.

Application Deadline: 16 November 2026.
